calibration_authority: Per-member MRC headers, which are uniform across all 459 nonlinear inputs and 51 primary references, internally 3x consistent and field-of-view consistent. The conflicting record-level imaging_conditions.xlsx value of 0.0626 um remains disclosed.

F-actin_nonlinear.reference_semantics: BioSR repository owner states SIM_gt_a.mrc was used to train the network; SIM_gt_b.mrc is a gamma-0.6 overview image. Only a is claim eligible.

physical_tensor.amendment_rule: Physical scales, estimators and response geometry are unchanged from v7; only the nonlinear grid calibration used to express those scales in pixels changes.

spectral_analysis.pair_rule: Apply identical physical frequency limits to input and reference. Spectral orientation is diagnostic only in v7.1.

tensor_orientation_distribution.interpretation: A complete axial orientation distribution remains defined for crossing, multimodal and near-isotropic structure; no scalar dominant-axis claim is made.

coherence_only_resolution_margin.operation: Gaussian blur on robustly normalized input before physical tensor measurement

support_contract.family_specific_rule: The strong resolution-margin component governs tensor coherence only. It is calculated and retained as a diagnostic for the orientation distribution but cannot alter orientation-distribution acceptance.

confirmation.field_selection_rule: Carry forward without change the eight nonlinear cells sealed in paired_acquisition_tensor_v7_confirmation_lock.json. No reselection is permitted.

separate_incremental_coherence_utility_r.not_assessable_rule: If conventional acquisition QC emits no invalid coherence case, incremental utility is not assessable and no superiority claim may be made. Measurement safety is decided separately.

comparators.conventional_acquisition_qc: The identical estimator governed only by acquisition-QC hard failures and its continuous acquisition-QC score.
comparators.always_emit: The identical estimator emitting every registration- and reference-eligible measurement.
comparators.comparison_scope: Incremental contract utility is tested only for tensor coherence.

amended_fields: confirmation scope and explicit carried-forward cells
scientific_parameters_changed: nonlinear physical grid calibration: 0.0626 um to 0.0604 um

access_boundary: Before this v7.1 candidate was written, all nonlinear MRC headers were audited and no nonlinear payload beyond the 1024-byte header, pixel array or endpoint outcome had been decoded. The linear confirmation was already completed under the unchanged v7 lock and is not rerun or reinterpreted by this amendment.
claim_boundary: Metadata-amended nonlinear paired-acquisition confirmation plus the separately locked v7 linear confirmation. Not image restoration, biological phenotype inference, diagnosis, clinical validity, diffraction-limit estimation, or proof that the reference reconstruction is ground-truth biology.
